findings: Carousel cross-fade overlap — AnimatePresence mode="sync" runs enter and exit simultaneously; two images are briefly stacked on slow devices. Change to mode="wait" to serialize. Cosmetic only.

Category tabs unresponsive during search — clicking a tab while search is non-empty has no visible effect, which may read as broken to first-time users. Consider hiding or greying out tabs when a search is active.

Takeaway order disappears on last table order close — if the only dine-in order leaves PENDING state while a PENDING takeaway order exists, the takeaway order instantly vanishes from the cashier view with no notification. No test or guard covers this transition.
